subject: Insurance
title: Whiplash Inflation
description: A fast breakdown of Whiplash Inflation for builders.

hook.text: Whiplash is the most common car accident injury—and the most faked. It can't be seen on X-rays.

buildup.text: After a real accident, victims may exaggerate symptoms. They claim months of therapy when the pain resolved in weeks.

discovery.text: The average whiplash claim in the US is $10,000-$15,000.

twist.text: The UK saw whiplash claims rise while accidents fell.

climax.text: Whiplash is real, but its invisibility makes fraud easy.

quiz.question: Why is whiplash commonly used in insurance fraud?
options: It can't be verified on imaging, relying on patient reports
